snippet.title: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction | Official Trailer #steam #indiegame
snippet.description:
Run a mad science shop by day. Pilot a giant robot by night.

Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction is a co-op comedy simulation for solo play or up to 4 players together. Stock your shelves, brew unstable potions and catch undercover agents posing as customers. When night falls, climb into your giant robot, smash 5 cities and defeat 5 superheroes to rise in the Society of World Destruction.

Release date: December 12, 2026
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4304890

Features:
• Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players
• Run and grow your own mad science supply shop
• Mix chemicals and discover new formulas (wrong mixtures may explode)
• Spot the real Society members and catch undercover agents
• Pilot a giant robot together and destroy 5 cities
• Defeat 5 superheroes and build the doomsday rocket

Developer: HAPPYTECH

#MadScientistSimulator #IndieGame #CoopGame #Steam
